title: Pointwise Kan extensions along inclusions of finite posets in infinity categories
statement: Let $A\subseteq B$ be finite partially ordered sets, with the order on $A$ induced from $B$, and let $j$ be the inclusion. The nerve $N(B)$ has $n$-simplices the nondecreasing chains $b_0\leq\cdots\leq b_n$; similarly for $N(A)$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. Let $\mathcal E$ be an infinity category, meaning a simplicial set with fillers for every inner horn $\Lambda^n_k\subset\Delta^n$, $0<k<n$, where $\Delta^n=N(\{0<\cdots<n\})$ and $\Lambda^n_k$ is the union of all codimension-one faces except the $k$th. Write $\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal E)$ for the simplicial set whose $n$-simplices are maps $K\times\Delta^n\to\mathcal E$; its vertices are coherent diagrams, and $j^*$ denotes restriction. For a diagram $H:N(A)\to\mathcal E$ and $b\in B$, set $A_{\leq b}=\{a\in A:a\leq b\}$ and $A_{\geq b}=\{a\in A:b\leq a\}$. A colimit is an object representing the space of coherent cocones by its mapping spaces, and a limit is defined dually; the empty colimit is an initial object and the empty limit a terminal object. If every diagram $H|_{A_{\leq b}}$ admits a colimit in $\mathcal E$, there is a coherent diagram $j_!H:N(B)\to\mathcal E$, with a unit $H\to j^*j_!H$ that is an equivalence, and canonical identifications $(j_!H)(b)\simeq\operatorname{colim}_{A_{\leq b}}H$ compatible with their cocones. Dually, if every diagram $H|_{A_{\geq b}}$ admits a limit, there is a coherent diagram $j_*H:N(B)\to\mathcal E$, with a counit $j^*j_*H\to H$ that is an equivalence, and canonical identifications $(j_*H)(b)\simeq\operatorname{lim}_{A_{\geq b}}H$ compatible with their cones. For every coherent diagram $T:N(B)\to\mathcal E$, the left adjunction has its counit $j_!j^*T\to T$ and the right adjunction has its unit $T\to j_*j^*T$ whenever the indicated extensions exist; together with the displayed unit and counit, these induce natural equivalences of mapping spaces $\operatorname{Map}(j_!H,T)\simeq\operatorname{Map}(H,j^*T)$ and $\operatorname{Map}(T,j_*H)\simeq\operatorname{Map}(j^*T,H)$. The extensions can be chosen functorially on the full subcategories of diagrams $H$ satisfying the corresponding local existence conditions, and all four units/counits and the mapping-space equivalences are natural on their respective domains: diagrams $H$ satisfying the corresponding local existence conditions and diagrams $T$ whose restrictions satisfy them. In particular, if $\mathcal E$ admits finite colimits, $j_!$ is a left adjoint to $j^*$ on all diagrams; if it admits finite limits, $j_*$ is a right adjoint to $j^*$ on all diagrams. These are infinity-categorical adjunctions and (co)limits, retaining coherent homotopies.

source.place: Lurie, Higher Topos Theory (March 10, 2012), Definition 4.3.2.2, Proposition 4.3.2.15, Corollary 4.3.2.16, Proposition 4.3.2.17 and Remark 4.3.2.18, printed pp. 271-272 and 284-285, specialized to full inclusions of nerves of finite posets; the right Kan assertion is the opposite-category statement.
